title: Injectivity of the Pair Encoding on Binary Expansions
statement: For all bit strings $x,y$ and natural numbers $i,j$, the encodings of $x$ paired with the binary expansion of $i$ and $y$ paired with the binary expansion of $j$ are equal if and only if $x=y$ and $i=j$.
